intro: Cyprus earns its living from tourism, shipping and financial services.

chapters.title: Tourism and shipping
text: Millions of tourists visit each year, and Limassol is one of the world's biggest centres for managing ships. In 2013 a banking crisis forced savers with large deposits to lose part of their money.

chapters.title: Halloumi and gas
text: Halloumi, a squeaky grilling cheese, has protected status in the EU as a Cypriot product. Gas has been found under the sea off the coast.
